messages:
liz: Quick notes from the routing policies editor design sync — capturing follow-ups. Main things: drag handle hit target feels small for pointer users; keyboard reorder flow needs clearer announcements; preview simulation sometimes shows wrong match counts after reorder. pranav: Agree re: handle. On mac trackpad it's fine but with a mouse it's easy to miss the target. sam: I can bump the handle hit area. Propose 36px visible handle + 8px hover buffer. maria: 36px might be a good compromise. 44px is the a11y recommendation for touch but list density suffers. julie: Accessibility note — screen readers currently say 'move' without context. Need aria-live announcements like 'Rule "Allow internal" moved to position 1'. pranav: Also the keyboard reorder (mod+up/down) doesn't announce the new position — we should add that. sam: Prototype aria snippet I'm thinking: ```
Rule "Allow internal" moved to position 2
``` This lets SR users get immediate feedback. liz: Validation copy: current 'No routes matched' reads like an error. Suggest: 'This rule does not match any requests. Add conditions or change priority.' Shorter alternative: 'No matching traffic — rule inactive.' maria: Simulation mismatch: after reordering rules the preview sometimes shows 0 matches but telemetry shows 24 hits. I think the sim uses a cached sample distribution. sam: Yep — cache invalidation issue. Options: invalidate sim cache on reorder, or mark sim results as "stale" and show a re-run CTA. julie: UX proposal: add a subtle warning pill: 'Sim results may be stale — re-run' and a primary 'Re-run simulation' button. pranav: Small copy tweak: change 'Rule applied to' -> 'Applies to' and 'Then' -> 'Then route to' for clarity. liz: Can we do a small canary: 1) handle size + hover area, 2) aria-live keyboard announcements, 3) stale-sim indicator + re-run CTA — roll to 10% of org accounts? dev-bot: Deployed branch routing-editor-ux-canary to staging — build 5123. sam: I'll take the handle + aria work, target EOD tomorrow. maria: I'll assemble a small prompt set to surface sim distribution edge cases and add to the evals repo. liz: Thanks. @julie can you open the copy PR with the suggested verbs and add unit tests for the strings? julie: On it — PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/412 liz: Perfect, merging after reviews. :thumbsup:
